text: Wednesday schedule: 25 games across MLB, Scottish Premiership, EFL Championship, and International Basketball. Early start: South East Melbourne Phoenix at Sydney Kings, 6:00 AM ET. MLB begins at 12:40 PM ET with Padres at Reds, then Braves-Nationals, A's-Rangers, Orioles-Rockies, Phillies-Dbacks, Mariners-Red Sox, Mets-Rays, and Giants-Pirates. Watch on MLB.TV, ESPN Unlmtd, Paramount+, SNY, NESN, MASN, and team networks. Follow @any_and_all_sports for daily schedules.
